title: What is GeBIZ BidOps?
caption: BidOps helps suppliers check whether a tender is still ready to bid — and what to fix when the requirements change.

title: One place to control bid readiness
caption: It connects tender requirements, company evidence, mandatory gates, preparation tasks and deadlines.

title: The bid starts FEASIBLE
caption: All 8 mandatory gates are verified. The submission package is 91% prepared and deadline risk is LOW.

title: Every requirement is traceable
caption: R17 requires at least 3 CISSP-certified engineers. Its source clause and supporting staff evidence are linked here.

title: Then the buyer issues a corrigendum
caption: The mandatory manpower requirement changes from 3 CISSP engineers to 4.

title: BidOps traces the impact
caption: It matches the change to R17, creates version 2, supersedes the old assessment and rechecks company evidence.

title: The bid becomes RECOVERABLE
caption: Only 3 complete evidence sets remain. The bid needs action, but it can still be recovered before closing.

title: A possible employee is not enough
caption: Engineer D has a verified CISSP, but the CV is stale and availability is unknown, so R17 cannot pass yet.

title: The evidence gap becomes a work plan
caption: Request the updated CV, confirm availability, revise the manpower schedule, then re-run R17 verification.

title: Not every bid can be recovered
caption: If a mandatory restriction has no credible recovery path, BidOps marks the bid BLOCKED.

title: Missing facts are never guessed
caption: If official wording or evidence is insufficient, BidOps keeps the bid UNCERTAIN and requests clarification.

title: Know what changed — and what to do next
caption: Requirement → Evidence → Assessment → Change → Impact → Recovery Action
